precedence: This addendum supersedes active donor capping, joint optimization, guaranteed fills and actual-no_fill-prefix selection in DESIGN.md. It specifies a not-yet-implemented split between OPEN-known conditional projection and unchanged final execution.

global_snapshot.book_id: hash of exact CLOSE snapshot, original sorted request list, native source hashes, frozen next-open rules and phase-separation contract
global_snapshot.deletion_sequence: lowest original ranked new MATURE SEED first; stable identity tie-break from original order
global_snapshot.shadow_id: branch with no new MATURE SEED
global_snapshot.inherited_boundary: Whole-day OHLC no_fill, including in forced exit_open, is unavailable to OPEN selection. Conditional prefix assumes known OPEN executable submission. Full original execution and all matching gates occur only after selection.

branch_record.branch_id: hash of exact retained N identities and full native CLOSE planning outputs
branch_record.N_retained_ids: subset along the fixed deletion chain; no arbitrary subset optimization
branch_record.open_selectable: CLOSE PASS only, starting at selected first-passing branch and its passing suffix; shadow included

receivers.origin: same original request, never synthesized at OPEN
receivers.bar_q_close: branch-specific original legal/planned/reference ceiling; zero when absent/removed/illegal/reference-zero; never union maximum
receivers.q_hat_close: native greedy reservation quantity under CLOSE-known projection, separately stored; not filled quantity or permission cap
receivers.open_bound: q_hat_open <= this branch bar_q_close using native known OPEN resizing; may exceed q_hat_close
receivers.side_effects: Scratch changes none. Final true lifecycle runs once: original EVENT priority_attempted may be consumed on actual attempt even without fill; event spent on actual fills; CP consumed on actual ADD fills.

donors.y_hat_close: native greedy projected sale quantity; compare to same-lot shadow, do not confuse with planned max_q
donors.open_bound: native projection must obey this branch max_q; if current healthy and y_hat_open > shadow y_hat_open, reject branch, do not clip donor
donors.forbidden: cross-branch max/min field mixing, caps assembled from different references, extra OPEN donor identities

informational_unions.receiver_ids: only helps enumerate conditional CLOSE-authorized requests; supplies no quantity cap
informational_unions.donor_ids: only helps enumerate conditional CLOSE-authorized lot candidates; supplies no quantity cap
informational_unions.execution_rule: choose exactly one branch_id; use every execution field from it; never execute the union

quantity_names.bar_q_C: CLOSE conditional authorization ceiling from native branch plan
quantity_names.q_hat_O: OPEN-known conditional native reservation/submittable projection, before any full-day no_fill, including forced-exit no_fill
quantity_names.fill_q: eventual original matching result, may differ from q_hat_O and must not feed selection
quantity_names.y_hat_O: OPEN-known conditional voluntary funding sale projection, not guaranteed realized sales after original matching

acceptance.demand_anchor_set: kind ADD OR phase EVENT; excludes RESIDUAL from lower bound
checks: for each current healthy lot: y_hat_candidate <= y_hat_shadow
for each ADD/EVENT identity: q_hat_candidate >= q_hat_shadow
acceptance.failed_branch: remove next lowest-priority N and consider next already frozen allowed branch; no active capping or reordering
acceptance.terminal: empty N is exactly unmodified native shadow; no special exemption
acceptance.original_residual: desired-versus-integer-reservation funding residue retained; new N may consume pre-existing shadow residue without additional healthy sales

forbidden_future_inputs: original exit_open actual simulation output already influenced by whole-day OHLC no_fill

common_health_snapshot.close_anchor: After original CLOSE I/CP/protection/equity/cash/event/ticket updates, before any candidate voluntary transfer or buy projection
common_health_snapshot.open_anchor: Read-only OPEN-known conditional prefix: original bridge/protection decisions; predict forced exits at known OPEN price/slippage/fees without full-day no_fill; predict cash/inventory/info_open/H before candidate voluntary trades. Never use original exit_open output after its OHLC no_fill.
common_health_snapshot.invariant: Every P0/PN uses exactly the same conditional prefix and H map. Neither branch-local trades nor later actual no_fill/forced-exit outcomes can recalculate selection health.
common_health_snapshot.allowed_update: Recompute once at next decision anchor; post-trade actual health is diagnostic only and cannot feed current comparison.
common_health_snapshot.actual_execution: After selection, run unchanged original actual prefix and selected-branch execution with no_fill at its original locations. Log deviations in actual H/cash/q/y; never feed them back to selection.

waiting_interface.reason: FUNDING_NONDISPLACEMENT_WAIT, a distinct explicit reason; never forged REFERENCE_CAP or structural false
waiting_interface.no_delete: Remove N only from scratch planner working set. Preserve true pending and ticket for original lifecycle; no new round or budget reset.
waiting_interface.real_open: Run original structural/source checks even while waiting: known false cancels, unknown pauses/blocks, valid but displaced waits.
waiting_interface.phase: Keep original phase snapshot; only original later lifecycle may reclassify. No MATURE-to-EVENT/RESIDUAL rewrite to bypass.
waiting_interface.preflight: Preserve all original preflight targets before filtering N; keep original Q0/source/bridge/action guards, atomic rollback and restored-target scan. Conditional unions do not shrink original coverage.
waiting_interface.side_effects: Withdrawal itself consumes no EVENT/CP. Real EVENT priority_attempted may be consumed by attempt even no fill; retain original rules.
